capabilities: Embedded SQL analytics with window/nested queries
limitation: Measure spill, memory and point-in-time correctness on bank workloads
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Versioned tables/files, explicit SQL and query configuration.
scientific_qualification.output: Materialized histories/features or score sufficient-statistic reductions.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Keys, joins, event/availability semantics and aggregation preserve the declared population and information set.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Use SQL windows/nested types where useful but separately enforce time and cardinality contracts. No bank-scale throughput inferred from the README.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Backfill and duplicate-key adversaries; compare a materialized temporal join with exhaustive small-table enumeration and record peak memory/spill for the actual workload.

evidence.finding: SQL windows/nested types, clients and CSV/Parquet input.
